name: LilysAI
description:
LilysAI turns YouTube videos, web articles, PDFs and audio into organized notes. This connector puts that library inside Claude.

Give Claude a link or a file and it registers the source in LilysAI, generates the note, and files it into the collection you name. Ask about something you saved last month and Claude searches your existing library and pulls the note body into the conversation — with the source URL, collection and creation time attached.

What you can do:
- Summarize a YouTube video or a web article and save it to a collection
- Compare notes across several papers you saved earlier
- Pull the highlights and memos you made last month into a draft
- Read the full transcript of a talk you saved
- Move projects between collections and keep the library tidy

The connector exposes 13 tools — 8 read-only (projects, collections, notes, transcripts, highlights, memos, account) and 5 write (create a project or note, update a project or collection, prepare a file upload). Search across your library is keyword matching, which the tool descriptions state plainly.

Requires a LilysAI account. Registering a new source consumes LilysAI credits; reading the library you already built does not.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LilysAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LilysAI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lilys.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LilysAI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LilysAI lists 13 MCP tools, including create_note, create_project, get_account, get_note, get_project, get_transcript, list_collections, list_highlights, list_memos, list_projects, prepare_upload, and save_collection.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LilysAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LilysAI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LilysAI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LilysAI is developed by LilysAI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
